headline: UK Commits $335,000 to Launch RiTA Investment Network in Nigeria
summary: The UK government has committed $335,000 to establish the RiTA Investment Network, aiming to channel domestic investment into women-led businesses in Nigeria.
why: Targeted micro-investments and gender-focused financial networks support inclusive economic development and SME growth in developing markets.

impacts.name: Financial Services
impacts.why: New funding networks increase capital access for domestic women-led enterprises.
